name: TPG

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (TPG Capital logo.svg, commons.wikimedia.org)

description: TPG is a global alternative asset manager with $303.0 billion of assets under management at 2025-12-31 across six platforms: Capital, Growth, Impact, Credit, Real Estate and Market Solutions. It raises funds from pensions, sovereign funds, insurers and wealth clients and charges management fees on committed or invested capital (fee-related revenues $2.11 billion in 2025), transaction and monitoring fees, and takes a share of investment profits (performance allocations, $2.01 billion in 2025 GAAP) when assets are sold. Fees are the steady base; performance allocations swing with exits and valuations. Credit and Real Estate came from the 2023 Angelo Gordon acquisition and Market Solutions grew with the July 2025 Peppertree acquisition.

hq.note: Corporate address Fort Worth per Wikipedia; operational hub 888 Seventh Avenue, New York per Wikipedia

employees.note: More than 1,900 people, including about 690 investment and operations professionals, over 1,000 non-investment and fundraising professionals and more than 200 support staff, in 16 countries (10-K).

businessLines.name: Capital
businessLines.how: Investors commit capital to flagship buyout funds and pay a management fee on committed then invested capital; TPG also takes a share of profits (performance allocations) when portfolio companies are sold.

businessLines.name: Growth
businessLines.how: Management fees on commitments to growth-equity and middle-market funds (Growth VI raised in the last twelve months), plus carried interest on exits.

businessLines.name: Impact
businessLines.how: Management fees on climate and impact funds (Rise Climate II, Global South and TI activated Q3 2025) plus a share of profits on exits.

businessLines.name: Credit
businessLines.how: Management fees on credit funds and separate accounts (Angelo Gordon heritage), fee base grows as capital is deployed (MMDL V, Credit Solutions III).

businessLines.name: Real Estate
businessLines.how: Management fees on real-estate funds (TREP, Realty, Europe Realty); fee base shrinks as older funds stop paying fees (Realty IX ceased Q2 2025) and grows with new funds.

businessLines.name: Market Solutions
businessLines.how: Management fees from the Peppertree funds (IX and X, acquired July 2025) and other TPG-ecosystem vehicles, plus fee-related performance revenues.

brands.name: Capital (TPG Capital, TPG Healthcare Partners, TPG Asia)
brands.note: Largest private equity platform, $90.9 billion AUM, 30 percent of firm AUM

brands.name: Angelo Gordon (acquired 2023-11-01)
brands.note: Source of the Credit and Real Estate platforms ($93.1bn + $38.2bn AUM, 43 percent of firm AUM combined)

brands.name: Peppertree (acquired July 2025)
brands.note: Within Market Solutions ($17.4bn AUM); added $4.5 billion of fee-earning AUM through acquisition
